visual.general_description: Combined bar and line chart titled "Changes of biochemistry parameters during hospitalization" with five bar series and two line series, two left-axis and right-axis scales, text labels for initiation and termination of glucocorticosteroid, and two yellow arrow bands labeled for intravenous and oral methylprednisolone.
visual.detailed_description: Twelve groups of vertical bars stand along an unlabeled horizontal axis; no date or day labels are printed under the groups. The legend lists AST (U/L), DBIL (umol/L), ALB (g/L), GGT (U/L) and ALP (U/L) as bars (blue, light green, teal, grey and purple-blue) and ALT (U/L) as a blue line with markers and TBIL (umol/L) as a yellow line with markers. The left vertical axis runs 0 to 2000 in steps of 200 and the right vertical axis runs 0 to 500 in steps of 50. Numeric data labels are printed on most bars and line points. The left-most group carries labels including 136, 51.6, 34.3, 306, 188.9, 132.9 and 60.9, and the right-most group carries labels including 396, 206.8, 33.3, 591, 649, 378 and 229.8. The blue ALT line labels read 132.9, 184.2, 175.5, 124.5, 187.3, 269.7, 290.6, 459.7, 341, 274, 456 and 378 from left to right, and the yellow TBIL line labels include 60.9, 84.3, 87.7, 98.2, 92, 84.3, 77.2, 95.1, 121.1, 101.5, 259.1 and 229.8. The tallest grey GGT bar carries 1816.7 and sits at the right of the middle of the chart. An orange down arrow under the text "Initiation of glucocorticosteroid" is in the left part of the chart and an orange down arrow under the text "Termination of glucocorticosteroid" is right of center. A yellow double-headed band labeled "Intravenous methylprednisolone" spans the left-center region and a yellow band labeled "Oral methylprednisolone" follows it to the right. The left-most group carries the ALT and TBIL labels 132.9 and 60.9, and the right-most group carries 378 and 229.8, the values the text gives as the last pre-discharge review and the initial tests, so the printed values read in the opposite order to the left-to-right order of the arrows; the highest ALT label (459.7) is right of center and the highest TBIL label (259.1) is second from the right.
